audit.description: The changed production code replaces `requests` imports with real `aiohttp` usage in `smartystreets_python_sdk/requests_sender.py`, including `aiohttp.ClientTimeout`, `aiohttp.ClientSession`, `session.request`, and `aiohttp.BasicAuth`. Static and dynamic evidence show no source-library imports from production repo code; the only observed `requests` imports came from an external `mock` dependency. The target module resolves to the installed `aiohttp` package in site-packages, with no local target provider or fake shim detected.
evidence: Unified diff: smartystreets_python_sdk/requests_sender.py removes `from requests import Session, Request` and adds `import aiohttp` plus ClientSession/session.request usage
Unified diff: smartystreets_python_sdk/custom_header_sender.py removes `from requests import Request` and delegates request construction to migrated requests_sender build_request
Static anti-cheat: requests_sender.py and proxy.py import target aiohttp; checked changed production files report imports_source=false and fake_target_added_code=false
Dynamic anti-cheat: first target import from production repo is smartystreets_python_sdk/requests_sender.py line 3 with origin site-packages/aiohttp/__init__.py
Dynamic anti-cheat: source_imports_from_production_repo_count=0 and source_imports_from_repo_count=0; requests imports only observed from site-packages/mock/mock.py
reasons: Changed production code meaningfully uses aiohttp APIs
Changed production code does not import or dynamically use requests
Target origin is installed aiohttp, not a local fake provider
